newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Goldfields sees Dec qtr improvement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Goldfields sees Dec qtr improvement.

text.p: Goldfields Ltd Managing Director Peter Cassidy said on Tuesday the gold miner's performance would improve in the December quarter compared with the September quarter of the year to June 30, 1997.
"There will be an improvement in the performance of the company in the second quarter compared with the first quarter," Cassidy told reporters after the company's annual meeting.
"We are estimating that that performance will continue through the third and fourth quarters," he said.
Cassidy said Goldfields expected a much stronger performance in the second quarter at the Porgera mine in Papua New Guinea, in which it has a 25 per cent stake.
Porgera produced 213,560 ounces in the September quarter, and the operators were still targetting 500,000 ounces for the first half, he said.

Goldfields also expected a better performance from its Henty mine in Tasmania as it mined higher grade ore, but the Kundana and Paddington mines were expected to operate at the same levels in the December quarter as in September.
Goldfields chairman Tony Cotton said earlier the average cost of production at Henty would not be known until the second half of the year.
However, the company had earlier estimated the cost of production at A$160 per ounce of gold, making it a very low cost mine, he said
